column1: #mapping_set_description: 'NCBI Datasets v2 genome sequence report: one JSON object per top-level sequence of an assembly (chromosomes, organelles, unlocalized/unplaced/alt/patch scaffolds). Served by GET /genome/accession/{accession}/sequence_reports, and in data packages as ncbi_dataset/data/<accession>/sequence_report.jsonl (camelCase).'
